messages:
Alina: Heads up — bringing up Zephyrus-13B (hf -> redwood convert) for int8 experiments. Quick repro shows perplexity jump ~+8% vs fp16 on our chat-summarize eval. Latency/cost looks fine, so I'm suspicious of a projection layout mismatch in the QKV/attn-proj (split vs fused) or a head-ordering mismatch.
Alina: Convert command I used:
```
python tools/convert_hf.py --model OrionZephyrus/zephyrus-13b --out redwood/zephyrus-13b --quant int8 --keep-weights
```
Alina: Sample eval (10k tokens corpus): fp16 ppl=12.3, int8 ppl=13.3. Top-1 next-token delta shows strange peaks on tokens around punctuation.
Jamie: Can you paste the eval script / exact prompt set? Also did you check tokenizer normalization (NFKC, lowercasing) during conversion?
Alina: Eval script is the usual bench/qa_eval.py with our summarize prompts. Quick snippet: `python bench/qa_eval.py --model redwood/zephyrus-13b --prompts data/summarize_10k.jsonl --tokens 10000` — tokenizer appears identical by hash, but I'll double-check mapping table.
Rafael: Two quick things to inspect: 1) check the state_dict param names for q/k/v projection layout (is it one fused `qkv.weight` or three `q_proj, k_proj, v_proj`?), 2) verify `kv_cache` head ordering vs runtime expects (head-major vs head-minor). I've seen conversions where HF uses fused `qkv` with interleaved heads — that will blow quantized logits if runtime assumes split.
Priya: Also check rotary scaling/offset. Mistral-style variants we've seen sometimes scale rotary differently per-head which interacts poorly with int8. If the convert script doesn't translate `rotary_scale`/`rope_freqs`, you'll get position-dependent drift.
Alina: Doing `torch.load` on the converted file shows `attn.q_proj.weight` + `attn.k_proj.weight` + `attn.v_proj.weight` (split) — HF source had `qkv.weight` fused. Converter created splits but I suspect the reshape/order is wrong (we might be reshaping `[3, H, D]` -> [q,k,v] by contiguous chunks whereas origin used interleaved heads).
Alina: Quick tensor inspect (head dim H=32): original qkv shape (3072, 4096) fused. After split we produced q,k,v shapes (1024,4096) each. But when I compute per-head cosine similarity between fp16 and converted int8 projections I see low similarity in the middle heads.
Jamie: Can you try running conversion with a `--qkv-split-mode=interleaved` option (if converter supports it) or add a small script to re-order slices? Also please try `--force-rotary-scale=legacy` to see if rotary normalization is the other culprit.
Alina: I added a `--qkv-split-mode=fused-interleave` flag locally and re-ran — int8 ppl dropped to 12.6 (much closer). So ordering was definitely the major factor.
Rafael: Great. That indicates runtime assumptions differ. We should: 1) add conversion autodetect that compares per-head cosines against fp16 baseline and warns, 2) add runtime compatibility layer that supports both head-orderings in KV cache.
Priya: I'll run tokenizer/vocab verification across 1M tokens to be safe (shadow vocab ids can amplify small logit diffs). Also will run rotary headwise phase test: give input with long repeating pattern and check phase drift across heads.
build-bot: CI kicked off: `eng-ml/zephyrus-convert` (matrix: split-mode tests, rotary variants) — https://ci.redwood/internal/12345
Alina: CI result: conversion matrix shows failures only for `qkv-default` path; `fused-interleave` and `split-correct` pass. PPL numbers attached in artifacts.
Jamie: Action items: Alina — open PR to make `fused-interleave` option default for known HF checkpoint patterns + add unit test that compares per-head cosine similarity. Rafael — audit runtime KV cache head ordering and add compatibility toggle. Priya — run tokenizer/vocab mapping sweep and rotary head test to rule out residual regressions.
Rafael: I'll also add a small microbench that verifies cross-model cache warm-start (fp16 -> quant) on a 10k prompt set to catch regressions in CI.
Alina: Thanks — I'll file the conversion PR and link bench results. Leaving a note: if anyone else sees perplexity bumps after convert, try re-running conversion with `--qkv-split-mode=fused-interleave` and check `per_head_cosine` in artifacts first. :thumbsup:
Priya: adding that to onboarding checklist and docs (convert README).
build-bot: CI finished: all matrix jobs complete, 2 warnings (rotary-scale mismatch heuristic) — see https://ci.redwood/internal/12345/artifacts
Jamie: Nice. If the PR lands we should run gated canary on dedicated capacity tomorrow. :eyes:
